title: 第7章 风华绝代小妖女第8章 倾世妖娆新师尊
slug: 被逐出宗门后师尊师姐后悔终生
content_zh:
此话一出，人们的脸色都变得无比严肃。
身怀魔种是极大的忌讳，为世人所不容，人人得而诛之！
应少玄的脸色也变了，他抓住周通的一条手臂，神光一扫，周通的掌心中果然渗出了一道魔气。
这种气息只能来自于天魔的身上。
所谓天魔，正是人类的天敌，以虐杀吞噬人类为乐，是所有人族共同的敌人。
看到这一幕，众人看向周通的眼神全都变了，充满了鄙夷和唾弃，更有甚者，恨不得将他大卸八块。
“原来是个魔崽子啊，亏我刚才还为他感到惋惜，真是一片好意都喂了狗！”
“能不能别侮辱狗？入魔之人连禽兽都不如，就应该将其立即斩杀！”
“呵呵…难怪他能变得那么强，原来是早就成魔了，或许他的本质就是个废物！”
应少玄的神色也变得无比凌厉，眼神如刀的盯着周通：“莫流苏所言可否属实？”
“不属实！”
没有丝毫犹豫，周通直接回应。
“到了现在你还敢信口开河，真是不见棺材不落泪，如今人证物证俱在，你再狡辩也无济于事！”
莫流苏毫不客气的挤兑周通，不遗余力的要将他逼进绝路。
“说的没错，对于这种入魔之人，没有什么好说的，只需一个字：杀！”
“杀了他！”
“杀了他吧！”
“不能让这魔崽子活下去，否则的话，不知道他还要害多少人！”
一时间人声鼎沸，山呼海啸般的讨伐起周通，入魔是所有人的底线，主动入魔者必除之！
“且慢，他的体内已无魔种！”

片刻之后，应少玄沉声说道，压下了繁杂的声音。
“这怎么可能？”
不少人都呆滞了，入魔的硬指标就是体内存在魔种，如今连魔种都不在了，谁又能说周通是魔头？
“不管怎么说，他跟魔族有染是不争的事实，为了保险起见，最好还是除掉为妙。”
有人提议道，得到了不少人的认可。
除恶务尽，宁错杀不放过，这是人族对魔族的态度。
应少玄也皱起了眉头，他对周通道：“按照大陆执法者的规矩，你这种情况除非有门派愿意为你做保，否则的话，即便不杀你也要封锁你的修为，让你永远无法修炼，你现在能否找到愿意为你做保的门派？”
此话一出，人们都看向了影像中的莫流苏。
“别看我，玉清宗是名门正派，怎么可能会为一个魔崽子做担保，各位可以随意处置他！”
莫流苏毫无感情的说道，唐七的眼中也充满了戏谑。
周通即便顿悟了又如何？最终还是逃不过沦落的命运，只有他唐七才是天命的主角！
“既然如此，那就没办法了。”
应少玄的神色变得冷厉：“按照规定，我要封锁你的修为，让你永远不能修炼。”
他靠近周通，缓缓的抬起手，就要施法。
“且慢，我们愿为他做保！”
就在这时，一道好听的声音传来，犹如清泉激荡，又像清风拂面，令人心旷神怡。
人群分开，一红衣少女飒然登场，刚一出现，就成为了众人的焦点。
“是她！”
看到此女，众人瞳孔一缩，这显然是个厉害人物。
只见少女如清水出芙蓉，赤裸的玉足踩在地面上，纤尘不染，步步生莲，摇曳生姿。
content_en:
As soon as these words came out, people's faces became extremely serious.
Being pregnant with a demonic seed is a huge taboo and is not tolerated by the world, and everyone will be punished if they find it!
Ying Shaoxuan's expression also changed. He grabbed one of Zhou Tong's arms, and with a sweep of divine light, a stream of demonic energy oozed out of Zhou Tong's palm.
This kind of aura can only come from the demon.
The so-called demons are the natural enemies of human beings. They take pleasure in killing and devouring human beings. They are the common enemy of all human beings.
Seeing this scene, everyone's eyes changed when they looked at Zhou Tong, full of contempt and contempt. What's more, they wanted to tear him into pieces.
"It turned out to be a devil kid. Fortunately, I felt sorry for him just now. All my good intentions were lost to the dog!"
"Can you please stop insulting dogs? A possessed person is worse than a beast and should be killed immediately!"
"Haha... No wonder he can become so strong. It turns out that he has become a demon a long time ago. Maybe he is just a waste at his core!"
Ying Shaoxuan's expression also became extremely sharp, and he stared at Zhou Tong with dagger-like eyes: "Is what Mo Liusu said true?"
"Not true!"
Without any hesitation, Zhou Tong responded directly.
"You still dare to talk nonsense now. It's true that you won't shed tears until you see the coffin. Now that there are witnesses and material evidence, it won't help you to quibble!"
Mo Liusu squeezed Zhou Tong unceremoniously and spared no effort to force him into a corner.
"That's right. There is nothing to say to such a possessed person, just one word: kill!"
"Kill him!"
"Kill him!"
"We can't let this devil kid live, otherwise, I don't know how many more people he will harm!"
For a time, there was an uproar of people, and a tsunami-like crusade against Zhou Tong began. Becoming a demon is the bottom line for everyone, and those who take the initiative to become a demon must be eliminated!
"Wait a minute, there is no more demon seed in his body!"
After a moment, Ying Shaoxuan said in a deep voice, suppressing the complicated sounds.
"How is this possible?"
Many people were stunned. The hard indicator of being possessed by a demon was the presence of a demon seed in the body. Now that the demon seed is no longer present, who can say that Zhou Tong is a demon?
"In any case, it is an indisputable fact that he has an affair with the demons. To be on the safe side, it is best to get rid of him."
Someone suggested, and it was recognized by many people.
When it comes to eradicating evil, one would rather kill someone by mistake than let go. This is the attitude of the human race towards the demon race.
Ying Shao
As soon as these words came out, everyone looked at Mo Liusu in the image.
"Don't look at me. The Yuqing Sect is a well-known and decent sect. How can it be possible for you to vouch for a devil kid? You can do whatever you want with him!"
Mo Liusu said without emotion, and Tang Qi's eyes were full of amusement.
So what if Zhou Tong had an epiphany? In the end, he still couldn't escape the fate of being reduced. Only he, Tang Qi, was the protagonist of destiny!
"If that's the case, there's nothing we can do about it."
Ying Shaoxuan's expression became cold and stern: "According to the regulations, I will block your cultivation so that you can never practice."
He approached Zhou Tong, slowly raised his hand, and was about to cast a spell.
"Wait a minute, we are willing to guarantee him!"
At this moment, a pleasant sound came, like a clear spring surging, and like a breeze blowing on the face, which made people feel relaxed and happy.
The crowd parted, and a girl in red suddenly appeared. As soon as she appeared, she became the focus of everyone.
"It's her!"
Everyone's pupils shrank when they saw this woman, she was obviously a powerful person.
I saw that the girl was like hibiscus emerging from clear water, with her naked jade feet stepping on the ground, spotless, with lotus growing and swaying every step of the way.
